faq.a1: Any wallet that supports BNB Smart Chain, including MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Coinbase Wallet, OKX Wallet and Binance Web3 Wallet. On mobile, open this site inside your wallet's browser. Our own HIVE Wallet is in development.
faq.a2: Not yet. The card is currently funded with USDT. HVX top-up is in development and will be announced on official channels.
faq.a3: No. The contract has no mint function and no owner. The supply is permanently 100,000,000,000 HVX.
faq.a4: Not at this time. Any listing will be announced only through official HIVE-X channels. Be careful of anyone offering HVX at a "pre-listing" price.
faq.a5: Only use the contract address on this page (0x252C…0028). HIVE-X will never ask for your seed phrase, private key or a transfer to "verify" your wallet.
